主要内容: In 2017, there was a notable shift in U.S. bankruptcies, with consumer discretionary companies, including retailers, experiencing a faster decline in cash flow compared to energy companies, which had previously dominated the bankruptcy landscape. This change was largely driven by the surge in online shopping, led by Amazon.com Inc. The impact was evident as retailers such as Gymboree Corp. and Rue21 Inc. faced store closures and defaults. This trend highlighted the growing influence of e-commerce and its effect on traditional retail businesses.
